description: Dermatology case. Exercises the § 6 Abs. 2 Analogansatz, including the collision rule that stops an analog position being charged twice, and the § 5 band for Abschnitt N.

analog_expectations.note: The closest analog (Nr. 750) is already charged directly for the dermatoscopy, so the @5 collision objective forces the next-best candidate. Charging Nr. 750 twice for two different services would be wrong.

factor_expectations.note: Abschnitt N (Histologie) is NOT named in § 5 Abs. 4, so it takes the general 3.5 band. Capping it at 1.3 like the lab section would undercharge it.
